title: Ruuh bi nekk ci ginaaw idol bi
intro: Ci lëndëmu génn gu mag ci nguuru jaay doole, nit ku yéeme kii dafa doon xaar ci àll bi. Bi njiitu askan wiñ tànn yéegee ci tundu wu sell ngir bokk ci Yàlla, fitna bu rëy dafa wàcci ci kaw ñi ñu bàyyi ci ginaaw. Nit ki dafa jël saa boobu ngir soppi ngëmu askan wi yépp. Bi njiit li delloo ak dëgg, ñu teg ko mbugal bu amul fenn. Ndax mën nga wax kan mooy ruuh bu bari coow te am njuuj njaaj?
clues: Maa ngi doon tukki ak askan wu ñu génne ci loxoy nootkat bu am doole jaaraleko ci ay kéemtaan yu yéeme.
Bi seen njiit yéegee ci tundu wi ngir jot ndigal, maa ngi xaar ci biir ñi des ci ginaaw.
Ma jël wen wu am solo ci seeni ornament daal di koy defaree luy defar bruit.
Jaarale ko ci mbindéef yii, ma gëmloo nit ñu bari ni gis nañu seen yàlla ci àll bi.
Bi njiit li delloo, ñu tànn ma, laaj ma lan moo ma yóbbe njuuj njaaj yooyu.
Sama yar ci àdduna bi mooy kenn duma laal wala jege, muy màndarga rus ci sama bopp ba fàww.

location.label: Ëlëm bu am solo
options: Gaam bu jigéen bu génn ci xeer
Gaal giñ tabax ci kaw tundu

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Dañu leen daan ngir ñu baña laal leen, di wax ba fàww 'bul laal'
Ñu ngi féey ci wetu tiran bi ak ay soldaaram
Sànni leen ci safara gu sedd ba noppi am jàmm
Ñu dóor ko ay bët yu bët ndax nangu wuñu dëgg
Mbokk yu fiir yi bàyyi nañu ko ci benn pax
outcome.answer: Dañu leen daan ngir ñu baña laal leen, di wax ba fàww 'bul laal'

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
